81–'85
is the first
greatest hits
album by Australian
pop rock
band
Men at Work
, released in November 1986. The album includes tracks from the band's three studio albums. The album reached number 42 on the Australian charts.
The album was re-released in 1992 as
The Works
and was certified platinum in Australia.
